info.name: Pulse — Core API (EN/ES)
info.description:
Pulse core backend. Bilingual (EN/ES) API collection.

Pulse — backend central. Colección bilingüe (EN/ES).

HOW TO USE / CÓMO USAR:
1. Run `php artisan migrate --seed` — the seeder PRINTS the credential_uids and reader api_keys to the console.
2. Set the collection variables below (classroom_reader_key, recycling_reader_key, credential_uid) to the printed values.

AUTH PATTERNS:
- Device endpoints (tap, classify): header `Authorization: Bearer <reader.api_key>`
- Admin/teacher endpoints (mode, redeem, nl-query): log in via the dashboard (session cookie) or use a personal access token.

Today (default) is filled with the Postman `{{$timestamp}}` where useful.

variable.description: A fresh card UID to pair / Un UID de tarjeta nueva para emparejar

item.name: 01 Device — Tap (Classroom) / Dispositivo — Tap (Aula)

request.description:
Phase B — the core presence loop.

Send the card's credential_uid; the reader is identified by its Bearer key (never trust a client-supplied reader ID).

Response 200: { status, event_id, event_type, student_first_name, next_step }
Response 401: invalid/missing Bearer token.
Response 404: card not recognized / not active.

Tip: set Accept-Language: es to receive Spanish messages.

item.name: 02 Device — Tap (Recycling) / Dispositivo — Tap (Reciclaje)

request.description: A recycling tap only logs the event; points are awarded AFTER classification. next_step = "awaiting_classification" — take event_id for the classify call.

item.name: 03 Device — Classify + Earn / Dispositivo — Clasificar + Ganar
04 Admin — Change reader mode / Cambiar modo del lector

request.description: Phase B — relabel a reader (CLASS_ATTENDANCE / PAE_BREAKFAST / PAE_LUNCH / RECYCLING_DEPOSIT / ENTRY). Admin-only (403 for teachers, 401 for guests). PUT works too.

item.name: 04b Admin — Create reader / Crear lector

request.description:
TASK-030-B (ADR-045) — provision a reader from the GUI: label + physical type (classroom/pae/recycling/entry) + initial mode. The server generates the 32-char API key and returns it EXACTLY ONCE (api_key + api_key_notice) — copy it now, it is never shown again. Admin-only.

Response 200: { status, reader: { id, label, type, active_event_type }, api_key, message, api_key_notice } + a reader_created roster frame.
Response 422: validation errors (nothing created).

item.name: 04c Admin — Rotate reader key / Rotar clave del lector

request.description:
TASK-030-B (ADR-045) — lost-key / suspected-leak recovery without SQL. The old key 401s from this moment (re-flash the fielded reader). The new key is returned EXACTLY ONCE. Admin-only.

Response 200: { status, reader: { id, label }, api_key, message, api_key_notice }.
Response 404: unknown reader.

item.name: 04d Admin — Delete reader / Eliminar lector

request.description:
Decommission a reader from the /admin/readers desk (overflow menu + confirm). The row goes with its tap events + deposits + pending captures (child-first deletes); pairing history survives unlinked, ledger balances keep their value, capture images are deleted, a reader_deleted roster frame drops the desk row live. Admin-only.

Response 200: { status, deleted: { id, label, events_deleted }, message }.
Response 404: unknown reader.

item.name: 05 Desk — Redeem reward / Canjear recompensa
05b Desk — Redemption failure example / Ejemplo de fallo

request.description: Redeem the 50-point 'Canteen discount voucher' with a low balance to see the clean 422 + shortfall.

item.name: 06 Admin — NL query / Consulta en lenguaje natural
08 Admin — Arm card pairing / Armar emparejamiento

request.description:
TASK-010 — step 1 of card pairing: arm a short-lived pending pairing (45 s window) for a student. Admin session or personal access token.

Response 200: { status, student_id, expires_at }
Response 401/403: guest / non-admin.
Response 404: unknown student.

Tip: set Accept-Language: es to receive Spanish messages.

item.name: 09 Device — Pair card / Emparejar tarjeta

request.description:
TASK-010 — step 2 of card pairing: submit a freshly scanned card UID. Auth is the READER Bearer key (same as the tap endpoint), not a user token.

Optional credential_kind (physical | hce, default physical): HOW the credential was captured — an Android HCE phone submits its application-level credential id with kind hce (AID F0010203040506; the RF UID is never identity). TASK-049 (ADR-068): kind hce REQUIRES the per-credential key hand-off — hce_nonce (16 hex), hce_mac (64 hex, HMAC-SHA256(K, credId||nonce)), hce_key_nonce (32 hex) and hce_key_wrapped (64 hex, K XOR HMAC-SHA256(reader_api_key, "pulse-hce-key-wrap/v1\n"||credId||"\n"||hce_key_nonce)). A body with kind hce is not hand-writable: generate it (scripts/e2e.sh hce_body) or use real hardware.

Response 200: { status, paired_student_name, student_id, rekeyed } — the card works immediately for taps (a phone's taps must carry hce_nonce + hce_mac).
Response 403: hce_proof_invalid — the phone's proof did not verify under the handed-over key (window stays armed).
Response 409: no pairing session active (none armed / expired / consumed).
Response 422: card already paired (never reassigned; the same student's active phone is re-keyed instead), or hce key material missing.
Response 401: missing/invalid reader key.

Tip: set Accept-Language: es to receive Spanish messages.

item.name: 10 Admin — Pairing desk status / Estado del escritorio de emparejamiento

request.description:
TASK-011 — read-only pairing-desk state: the armed session (student + seconds left), the last completed pairing, and the 8 most recent completions. The dashboard "Pair cards" page polls this while a session is armed.

Response 200: { status, pending: {student_id, student_name, expires_at, seconds_left} | null, last_pairing: {card_uid, student_name, paired_at, reader_label} | null, recent_pairings: [...] }
Response 401/403: guest / non-admin.

This endpoint never writes: arming stays a POST, pairing stays reader-side.

Sugerencia: Accept-Language: es para mensajes en español.

item.name: 10b Admin — Settings (read) / Configuración (leer)

request.description: TASK-037 — effective runtime settings (settings row → config default): meal serving windows, late cutoff, pairing window, student account conventions + which keys are customized.

item.name: 10c Admin — Settings (update) / Configuración (guardar)

request.description: TASK-037 — validate + persist a partial batch. HH:MM windows (breakfast/lunch must not overlap), late cutoff, pairing window 10–600 s. Live for the next request: the meal engine, the late computation and arming all resolve through SettingsService.

item.name: 10d Admin — Revoke credential / Revocar credencial
12 Admin — Tap (Cafeteria, meal engine) / Tap (Cafetería, motor de comidas)

request.description: TASK-037 — a meal-reader tap goes through the serving engine: the meal is AUTO-DETECTED from the configured windows (the reader mode label is not the meal authority). 200 = served (meal + message); 422 = flagged attempt with reason: weekend | out_of_window | window_overlap | no_student | not_enrolled | no_attendance | duplicate (message names the meal; attempt is recorded, never counted).

item.name: 11 Admin — Backfill student login / Crear acceso de estudiante

request.description:
TASK-030-A (ADR-044) — one-click login for a student row with no account (pre-TASK-030 rows). Idempotent: already=true keeps the existing login and never re-issues the temporary password.

Response 200 fresh: { status, already: false, account: { email, temporary_password, must_change_password } } — the ONLY place the temporary password appears.
Response 200 existing: { status, already: true, account: { email } }.
Response 401/403: guest / non-admin.
Response 404: unknown student.

Tip: set Accept-Language: es to receive Spanish messages.

item.name: 12 Admin — Create staff login / Crear acceso de personal

request.description:
TASK-038 (ADR-058) — create an admin, teacher or kitchen login from the /admin/staff desk (no seeder, no SQL). The admin chooses the temporary password (min 8, confirmed); first login forces rotation.

Response 200: { status, staff: { id, name, email, role, classes }, account: { email, temporary_password, must_change_password }, message, account_notice } — the ONLY place the temporary password appears. Teachers may take homeroom classes via class_ids (same transaction; class_ids on any other role is 422 classes_teacher_only).
Response 422 duplicate: the email already exists (case-insensitive).
Response 401/403: guest / non-admin.

Tip: set Accept-Language: es to receive Spanish messages.
